claim: In master_connection.go lines 50-72, EnsureDefaultMasterConnection updates cdc_system.master_binding.transform_spec with pk from source_object_registry.primary_key_field when transform_type <> flatten and transform_spec->>pk is empty.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/cdc-cms-service/internal/bootstrap/master_connection.go:50-75
	// Chuẩn hóa cấu hình transform_spec.pk từ source_object_registry.primary_key_field
	// cho các master_binding cũ được tạo trước khi có trường pk trong transform_spec.
	backfillRes := db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`
		UPDATE cdc_system.master_binding mb
		   SET transform_spec = jsonb_set(
		           CASE
		               WHEN mb.transform_spec IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(mb.transform_spec) <> 'object' THEN '{}'::jsonb
		               ELSE mb.transform_spec
		           END,
		           '{pk}',
		           to_jsonb(BTRIM(sor.primary_key_field)),
		           true
		       ),
		       updated_at = NOW()
		  FROM cdc_system.source_object_registry sor
		 WHERE sor.id = mb.source_object_id
		   AND COALESCE(mb.transform_type, '') <> 'flatten'
		   AND COALESCE(BTRIM(mb.transform_spec->>'pk'), '') = ''
		   AND COALESCE(BTRIM(sor.primary_key_field), '') <> ''
	`)
	if backfillRes.Error != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("backfill master_binding transform_spec.pk: %w", backfillRes.Error)
	}

	logger.Info("master connection seeded",
		zap.String("connection_code", "default_master"),
